name: News cards show dates within the last 7 days
description: Related news articles should be recent. Any visible publication date should be within the past 7 days of the current date, not months-old articles.

planSteps.description: Click on a bracket match to open a match detail page
Read the publication dates shown on the news cards

Verify the publication dates shown on the news cards are recent. Dates like 'today', 'yesterday', '2 days ago', '5 days ago', or an ISO date within the last 7 days are acceptable. Dates showing articles from weeks or months ago fail this test.
